sources.title: S. Hrg. 115-508, President’s Budget Request for the U.S. Department of the Interior for FY 2019, hearing of March 13, 2018
sources.locator: Zinke written answers, pp. 96–97, questions 8 and 10, esp. question 8. The answer to question 8 explicitly identifies the submission of the final report to the President in December 2017; repeats month in question 10.

sources.title: Interior written answers, House Natural Resources Committee, March 15, 2018 budget hearing
sources.locator: printed pp. 26–27, answers to comment questions 1–2 (immediately before question about predominance of pro-designation comments). Department attributes final report submission to the President to December 2017. Corroborating institutional account, not an independent receipt.

“Bears Ears & Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument Boundary Modifications”; separate 2019 testimony. Attributes specific Dec 4 action to presidential consideration of final report’s recommendations; establishes access to recommendations by Dec 4, not documentary delivery of final version by Dec 4.
Dec 5, 2017 release, first paragraph. BLM describes release of final report outlining recommendations already made.

conclusion: The previously broad submission-by-Jan-30 statement is true but can be narrowed: the Secretary reported that the final report was submitted in December 2017. Bound December 1 through December 31 (calendar envelope only); no exact day. Do not substitute Dec 4 (President acted after considering recommendations) or Dec 5 (public release). The August 24 transmission was a draft, not established as the submission of the final; the December final submission was after the August deadline. This does not adjudicate the sufficiency of an August draft for purposes of interim compliance, each routing receipt or the first end of the whole order. Next acquire the Senate PDF / printed pp.96–97, plus the House backup, for pinned native use; a dated transmitted version/White House receipt remains open.
